trigger: After the completed US_2024 bounded-continuation merge, aggregate validation found that physical Parquet feature-column order differed between US_2024 and the four non-US family matrices.

observed_state.first_observed_order_difference: last_interarrival_seconds placement relative to windowed anonymous-activity features

change.aggregate_validation: Require identical feature name sets with no duplicates, identical feature/target counts and identical frozen spec hash; retain US_2024 feature ordering as the canonical aggregate order.
change.stage_3_validation: Require identical feature name sets with no duplicates and identical target ordering; select all downstream matrices explicitly by canonical feature names.

note: This amendment resolves non-semantic physical column ordering only. It must not be used to alter or rescue empirical results.
